basic_info.description: Top-floor, two level contemporary loft-condo in Nob Hill. 2BR/2BA, 1 car parking. Open floor plan with vaulted ceilings, bay window, multiple skylights gets great natural light. Walkable Polk Street location close to restaurants, cafes, Bi-Rite Grocery, boutique shops, vibrant nightlife, and public transportation. Property is on the edge of Nob Hill, Russian Hill and Pacific Heights. 12 unit building with elevator, built in 2006. Top of the line stainless steel appliances, Viking gas range, dishwasher, stone counter tops. Wood floors. In unit stacked washer/dryer.
